title_zh: 在染布工作坊完成浸染并确认沥干位置

scenario.label_zh: 按工作坊说明完成布料浸染步骤
scenario.goal_zh: 按教师说明溶解染料、浸入布料，并将布料放在指定托盘上方的架子上沥干

context_zh: 使用教师提供材料的入门染布工作坊中，学员核对操作顺序。
author: author-phase10-c

sentences.speaker: Tess
sentences.text: Shall I dip the cloth in now?

sentences.speaker: Rowan
sentences.text: Not yet. Keep your gloves on and stir gently until the dye crystals dissolve. Use only the mixture I prepared.

sentences.speaker: Tess
sentences.text: They have dissolved now. I cannot see any crystals at the bottom.

sentences.speaker: Rowan
sentences.text: Good. Lower this small cloth into the mixture and hold it there while I count.

sentences.speaker: Tess
sentences.text: It is in. Tell me when to lift it.

sentences.speaker: Rowan
sentences.text: Now. Let it drain over this tray, not over the clean cloths.

sentences.speaker: Tess
sentences.text: I have put it on the rack above the tray. Is that the right place?

sentences.speaker: Rowan
sentences.text: Yes. Leave it there; we will check the colour once it has finished draining.
